name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: Right-click, long-press and keyboard menu with the same parts and styles as the Dropdown Menu, built on Reka UI.

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ContextMenuRootEmits, ContextMenuRootProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { ContextMenuRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'

const props = defineProps<ContextMenuRootProps>()
const emits = defineEmits<ContextMenuRootEmits>()

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <ContextMenuRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="context-menu"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </ContextMenuRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ContextMenuContentEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { ContextMenuContentProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuPortal, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { menuContentClass } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = defineProps<ContextMenuContentProps>()
const emits = defineEmits<ContextMenuContentEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <ContextMenuPortal>
    <ContextMenuContent
      data-slot="context-menu-content"
      v-bind="{ ...$attrs, ...forwarded }"
      :class="cn(
        menuContentClass,
        'max-h-(--reka-context-menu-content-available-height) origin-(--reka-context-menu-content-transform-origin)',
        props.class,
      )"
    >
      <slot />
    </ContextMenuContent>
  </ContextMenuPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ContextMenuGroupProps } from 'reka-ui'

const props = defineProps<ContextMenuGroupProps>()
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props)
</script>

<template>

    <slot />
  </ContextMenuGroup>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ContextMenuItemEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { ContextMenuItemProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { ContextMenuItem, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { menuItemVariants } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ContextMenuItemProps>(), {
  variant: 'default',
})
const emits = defineEmits<ContextMenuItemEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'variant', 'inset')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <ContextMenuItem
    data-slot="context-menu-item"
    :data-variant="props.variant"
    :data-inset="props.inset ? '' : undefined"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn(menuItemVariants({ variant: props.variant }), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </ContextMenuItem>
</template>

    <slot />

        'max-h-(--reka-context-menu-content-available-height) origin-(--reka-context-menu-content-transform-origin)',
        props.class,
      )"
    >
      <slot />
    </ContextMenuSubContent>
  </ContextMenuPortal>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ContextMenuSubTriggerProps } from './index'
import { ChevronRight } from '@lucide/vue'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { ContextMenuSubTrigger, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { menuItemVariants } from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'

  >
    <slot />
    <ChevronRight class="ml-auto size-4 rtl:rotate-180" />
  </ContextMenuSubTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
